title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Mileage Prompt Credit
content:
When a mileage adjustment is approved on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the mileage prompt credit is added after the claimed amount has been multiplied by any share applying to it. It is counted in calendar days from the batch's completion date to the date the mileage dispute was submitted:

| Calendar days from completion date to submission of the mileage dispute | Credit |
|---|---|
| Zero or one | 0.40 |
| Two to four | 0.20 |
| Five or more | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, batch completed 20 October)

| Mileage dispute submitted | Days | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 21 October | 1 | 0.40 |
| 22 October | 2 | 0.20 |
| 24 October | 4 | 0.20 |
| 25 October | 5 | Nothing |
